svg.title: Multi-branch progressive stem
svg.desc: The same input X supplies the main, detail and high-pass paths. Outputs have 16, 8 and 4 channels at 320 by 320 and concatenate to form Z. The spatial gate produces a one-channel weight that is broadcast across Z. A pair of fusion convolutions and the final stride-two convolution generate a 16 by 160 by 160 output. The two crops illustrate the high-pass operation on an archived image and are not learned activations.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 2. Scientific source: EnhancedStemBlock.py and manuscript section 3.2. Design reference: TokenFlow (CVPR 2025), Figure 3, for the relationship between image examples and feature glyphs. Visual example: VisDrone 0000001_02999_d_0000005.jpg, cropped to (266, 330, 386, 450) after an evaluation-size resize; signed luminance residual extracted from X−AvgPool3×3(X), displayed with a fixed contrast stretch.
